top_story.title: ArrowMark Financial Corp. Announces Monthly Cash Distribution of $0.15 per Share for October 2026
top_story.summary: DENVER, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ArrowMark Financial Corp. (Nasdaq: BANX) ("ArrowMark Financial" or the "Company"), an SEC registered closed-end management investment company, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a monthly cash distribution of $0.15 per share for October 2026.
